item.title: RouterOS 7.25rc2 [testing]
item.ns0:encoded:
What's new in 7.25rc2 (2026-10-09):

*) bridge - fix DHCP snooping dropping DHCP messages on trusted ports when the source MAC differs from chaddr (introduced in v7.25beta3);
*) container - fix veth interfaces not getting an address from the correct DHCP server when a PVID is configured (introduced in v7.25beta3);
*) defconf - fix button script policies;
*) defconf - fix default configuration generation when CRS8xx series switch ports initialize late;
*) dude - fix the server not starting at boot when data-directory is on a USB disk;
*) ipsec - fix IPsec tunnels failing after migration from the old QKD settings;
*) ipv6 - fix cases when address is lost after reboot if prefix was taken from pool (additional fixes);
